{{Quote|The Trianii's basic goal has been to make our taking their land more trouble than its worth. They have certainly succeeded, but at a horrible price. Fully a third of their young have been consumed and destroyed in this jyhad. I suspect both sides are ready to come to some sort of accommodation.|Halbreck Dodd|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
'''Halbreck Dodd''' was an employee of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Dodd was one of the CSA's negotiators that attempted to end the border war between the Authority and the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]].
